ai_language_tip: English is fine for almost all business calls; switch to Filipino/Taglish (tl) if the staff does, and add 'po/opo' for politeness; in Cebu/Visayas staff may prefer Cebuano but understand English and Tagalog.
english_ok: yes — English is an official language and used in business, clinics and government; rural staff may answer more comfortably in Filipino or a local language.
politeness: Warm and polite: use 'po/opo', Sir/Ma'am; avoid blunt refusals; thank with 'thank you po' or 'salamat po'.
name_tip: Western-style first name + surname; address as Sir/Ma'am, or Kuya/Ate for friendly informality; bookings go under surname or full name + mobile.
phone_tip: Mobile 11 digits starting 09 (09XX-123-4567 style); Metro Manila landline (02) 1234-5678; read back in 4-3-4 groups; Viber often uses the same number.
time_tip: Clock time mixes English ('7 pm') and Spanish-based Filipino ('alas-siyete ng gabi'); add ng umaga/hapon/gabi; written as 7:30 PM; always read back with AM/PM.
number_tip: Phone numbers and prices are usually read in English digits; Spanish-derived numbers are used for clock time in Filipino ('alas-siyete'); prices in pesos.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 12:00–13:00, dinner rush 18:00–20:00 at restaurants, calls after 21:00, Holy Week (Maundy Thursday–Good Friday) and Christmas Eve/New Year's Eve when many shops close early.
closed_days: Office weekend is Sat–Sun but malls and most shops open daily; government offices close weekends; Holy Week and Christmas–New Year are the main closures; holidays are often moved to Mondays.
booking_channels: Facebook Messenger (business pages) is the top booking channel, followed by SMS, phone calls and Viber; GrabFood/foodpanda for delivery; Grab for rides; online appointment portals for government IDs.
voice_menu: Telcos (Globe, Smart), banks, Meralco and courier hotlines use IVR in English/Filipino; small shops answer directly or reply on Messenger.
callback_habits: Shops usually confirm by Messenger or SMS; clinics and salons text a reminder the day before; couriers text or call on delivery day.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 跳島、潛水與一日遊多用 Messenger 預約並付訂金；部分景點要先線上登記或付環境費。

may_come_up.what: Island hopping price is per boat or per head
Environmental fee paid on site

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full names and ages of every guest for the manifest

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊與美甲多 Messenger 或電話預約，商場內連鎖店接受現場排隊（walk-in）。

may_come_up.what: Mall salon says walk-ins are accepted on a first-come basis
Rebond or keratin price depends on hair length

sensitive_asked.what: Asks GCash full payment before giving a slot

usually_asked: Service: haircut, rebond, mani-pedi, foot spa

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消在原本的 Messenger、簡訊或電話處理；HMO 線上預約要至少在數小時前改期。

may_come_up.what: Down payment is non-refundable but may be moved to a new date
HMO scheduler asks to reschedule at least 4 hours ahead

sensitive_asked.what: Asks HMO card number to find the appointment

usually_asked: Reference number from SMS or e-mail

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 醫師多有固定看診時段（clinic hours），常以到診順序；有 HMO 的病人要確認醫師是否為認可醫師，部分醫院門診須先申請 LOA，HMO 直營診所可直接到診。

may_come_up.what: HMO-run primary care clinics take walk-ins without an LOA
Doctor sees patients first-come, first-served during clinic hours

sensitive_asked.what: Asks HMO card number and birthdate

usually_asked: LOA reference if the hospital requires one

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Globe、Smart）、銀行與 Meralco 客服有英語／菲律賓語語音選單，帳戶事項須本人驗證。

may_come_up.what: Hotline says only the account owner can request changes

sensitive_asked.what: Asks account number, birthdate or OTP

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 護照、NBI 良民證、駕照等多走各機關線上預約系統再到場；學校可電話或 Facebook 粉專詢問。

may_come_up.what: NBI clearance requires an online appointment and two valid IDs

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 冷氣清洗、水電與清潔多電話或 Messenger 叫；住宅社區（subdivision）與公寓要先向保全或管理處申請工作許可。

may_come_up.what: Aircon cleaning priced per unit, window or split type
Condo admin requires a work permit for contractors

sensitive_asked.what: Asks GCash before the technician leaves the shop

usually_asked: Window or split-type aircon, how many
Address with Blk/Lot, subdivision or condo tower

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店多經 Agoda、Booking.com，度假村與海島民宿常用 Messenger 或電話，旺季要先付訂金；入住須出示身分證件。

may_come_up.what: Valid ID needed at check-in
Island resort asks a bank or GCash down payment in peak season

usually_asked: Number of guests and extra mattress

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、聖週與聖誕假期是否營業、可否用 GCash 或 Maya、有無停車位，店家多在 Messenger 直接回答。

may_come_up.what: Gives Holy Week and Christmas holiday hours
Says GCash, Maya or cards are accepted

pet.before_dialing_zh: 動物醫院與寵物美容多可電話或 Messenger 預約；寵物旅館要求疫苗卡。

may_come_up.what: Grooming price by size small, medium, large
Clinic asks for the vaccine card

sensitive_asked.what: Pet boarding asks full payment to a personal GCash

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 Lamudi、Facebook 社團與 Marketplace，仲介習慣 Messenger 或 Viber 約看房；常見「一個月押金加一個月預付」。

may_come_up.what: Agent continues on Viber or Messenger
Post-dated cheques for the lease term

sensitive_asked.what: Asks reservation fee before showing the unit

usually_asked: Condo tower or house and listing

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽車定期保養（PMS）可電話或原廠網站預約；機車與小修理行（talyer）多直接到場。

may_come_up.what: Casa (dealer) books PMS by odometer reading
Talyer gives a quote only after inspecting the car

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 菲律賓餐廳多透過 Facebook 粉專 Messenger、電話或簡訊訂位；生日與團體會問人數上限、包場消費額（consumable）與是否可自帶蛋糕，可能收 GCash 訂金。

may_come_up.what: Function room needs a minimum consumable amount and GCash down payment
Page admin replies on Messenger instead of the phone
Corkage fee for bringing a cake or wine

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a screenshot of the GCash payment with the sender's name

usually_asked: Name under the booking and mobile
Occasion such as birthday, with cake to bring

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、bilao 大盤菜與花束常用 Messenger 預訂並先付 GCash 訂金，聖誕節前要很早。

may_come_up.what: Custom cake needs 50 percent down payment via GCash

sensitive_asked.what: Asks payment to a GCash name different from the shop

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 餐廳可電話或 Messenger 點餐自取，外送以 GrabFood、foodpanda 為主；派對大盤菜（bilao）要提前訂。

may_come_up.what: Delivery only through GrabFood or foodpanda
Pay through GCash or Maya on pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Asks GCash to a personal number before a small order

tracking.before_dialing_zh: LBC、J&T、Flash 多用官網或 App 以追蹤號查件；同城急送常用 Lalamove，在 App 內聯絡司機。

may_come_up.what: Courier hotline points to tracking on its website

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車以 Grab 為主，菲律賓 Grab 不提供預約叫車；機場接送與包車（van rental）多 Messenger 或電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Grab rides cannot be scheduled ahead in the Philippines
Van rental rate per day, driver meals and toll extra

sensitive_asked.what: Self-drive rental asks driver's licence and valid IDs

usually_asked: Pax and luggage, van or sedan
